elements.p: Five seas circle Wavebreak Port. A seal keeps each outer sea closed until you kill the beast that guards the one before it. If you try to sail past a sealed border, the sea pushes you back.

Warm shallows, jungle islands called the Island Thickets, and deep Open Ocean where sharks hunt. Banana and coconut palms grow on the islands. Castaways live on the beaches; cursed monkeys and crabs live in the jungle.
Smugglers' Grottos hidden under boulders, Tidewater Shrines, and Sunken Galleons (some run aground and still stick out of the waves).

elements.torn: The chart of the second sea is missing. Kill Captain Rackham.

elements.p: Coral Bay, the Reef Edge and the Siren Sea. Coral jellies drift in bright swarms and sting. SIRENS sing to pull sailors in. A helmet halves their song; a turtle shell blocks it completely.
The Coral Temple is here, and so is the Serpent's stone gate.

elements.torn: The chart of the third sea is charred. Kill the Sea Serpent.
The chart of the third sea is charred. Keep hunting.

elements.p: The Ash Reef, the Boiling Basin and the Magma Sea. The WATER HERE SCALDS; a Tide Pearl or a Heat Amulet protects you. Magma Brutes slam the ground (water and rain hurt them), and lava crabs set you on fire.
Look for the Obsidian Vault, the fire pirates' camps, and the Cinder Citadel.

elements.torn: The chart of the fourth sea is blank except for a drowned man's thumbprint. Kill the Molten Warlord.
The chart of the fourth sea is blank except for a drowned man's thumbprint. Keep hunting.

elements.p: Phantom Wake, the Shipgrave Depths and the Drowned Trench. Lightning, fog and the drowned. Some of the chests in the Drowned Graveyard are MIMICS, so don't get too close.

elements.torn: The last chart ends in a black edge. Kill the Ghost Captain.
The last chart ends in a black edge. Keep hunting.

elements.p: The Abyssal Rings, the Pillar Sea and the Maw Depths: the edge of the world. MADNESS creeps in out here; the Spectral Anchor or a Sanity Amulet keeps your mind clear. Abyssal Anglers flash their lures to blind you, then lunge.
The Luminous Grotto glows down in the dark.
They live in the open water of the Starter Seas and breach to bite. Don't swim far from your ship.
Thieves. They snatch items and run into the trees.
Dead pirates who still sail. In the outer seas you'll find more of them than living ones.
